findings.location: content.body.scope.noteUk: «З прикметником артикль з’являється (Es un médico muy bueno)»; content.body.ruleUk: «ким людина працює чи навчається».
findings.description: An adjective does not automatically require an article: classifying combinations such as médico rural can remain bare. The Ukrainian wording also incorrectly extends «ким» to «навчається».
findings.suggestion: Distinguish classifying modifiers from evaluative noun phrases with un/una. Replace the Ukrainian opening with wording about naming a profession or occupation, such as «Коли називаємо професію чи рід занять…».

items.reviewerAnswer: Neutral occupation statements normally use a bare noun: Soy profesora. Ana es estudiante. Pablo es médico. Classifying modifiers can also occur without an article: Es médico rural.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, nominal attributes with profession nouns and the indefinite article (from memory).
Словник української мови в 11 томах, entry «навчатися», constructions for studying a profession (from memory).
Course contract rule 8.

findings.location: content.body.steps[id=s6].blocks[0].text: «Коли кажемо, ким людина працює чи навчається».
findings.description: The wording incorrectly coordinates «працює» and «навчається» under «ким». Standard Ukrainian expresses studying for a profession with a construction such as «навчається на лікаря».
findings.suggestion: Rewrite the opening as «Коли називаємо професію чи рід занять…» and retain the occupation examples.

items.reviewerAnswer: Use ser for identification, origin, nationality, occupation and description; practise nationality agreement, introduction formulas, form fields and short listening comprehension.
sources: Course contract rule 8.

findings.location: task.options[id=c]: label «Mis amigos.», outcome «incorrect»; feedbackUk: «Без дієслова це лише «мої друзі»; «це мої друзі» — Son mis amigos.»
findings.description: A nominal phrase is a natural photo caption. The prompt asks what to write under the photo and does not require a complete sentence, so lacking a verb does not make c incorrect.
findings.suggestion: Accept c, or explicitly ask the learner to choose a complete sentence containing ser.

items.reviewerAnswer: a and c. Both Son mis amigos. and Mis amigos. work as photo captions.
sources: Course contract rule 2.

findings.location: task.prompt[0].text: «Ти підписуєш фото з друзями: «Мої друзі з Іспанії».»
findings.description: The Ukrainian text permits either a statement that the friends are from Spain or a nominal caption identifying the friends from Spain. The reviewed key covers only the statement, and the prompt does not specify a complete sentence.
findings.suggestion: Specify whether the learner must write a complete statement of origin or a nominal photo caption, then align the reviewed answers.

items.reviewerAnswer: Mis amigos son de España. A nominal caption is also possible: Mis amigos de España.
items.notes: The key is open; this is an unresolved prompt interpretation, not a claim that every unlisted caption is graded incorrect.

findings.location: task.errors[id=e2].feedbackUk: «Son — для ellos або ввічливого ustedes; друзям на «ти» в Іспанії — sois.»
findings.description: The explanation makes a Spain-wide claim that ustedes is formal. Informal ustedes with third-person plural agreement also occurs in parts of peninsular Spain, notably Andalusia.
findings.suggestion: Describe vosotros/sois as the usual informal plural in most of Spain. If this task specifically requires vosotros, state that explicitly instead of treating the regional alternative as exclusively formal.

items.reviewerAnswer: Sois muy inteligentes. Vosotros sois muy inteligentes. Informal ustedes can also license Son muy inteligentes in parts of Andalusia.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, entry «usted», plural address and informal use in parts of Andalusia (from memory).

findings.location: task.errors[id=e1]: text «española.», outcome «incorrect»; feedbackUk: «Хав’єр — чоловік: español.»
findings.description: A nationality field can use an adjective agreeing with the feminine noun nacionalidad. Therefore española is a standard acceptable entry for Javier and cannot be rejected because he is male.
findings.suggestion: Accept española and explain agreement with nacionalidad. Distinguish a nationality-field entry from a personal statement such as Soy español.

items.reviewerAnswer: española, agreeing with the field label nacionalidad.
sources: Course contract rule 3.
RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, entry «concordancia», nominal gender agreement (from memory).
RAE/ASALE, Diccionario de la lengua española, entry «nacionalidad», feminine noun (from memory).

findings.location: task.prompt[0].text: «Ти заповнюєш анкету на мовні курси за свою подругу Ганну — вона німкеня. Що вписати в поле?»; context.taughtBefore lists «alemán» but not «alemana» or the consonant-ending nationality agreement rule.
findings.description: Producing alemana requires this lesson's exceptional consonant-ending nationality pattern. The case maps regular -o/-a agreement and alemán, but does not establish that prerequisite or gloss the required feminine form.
findings.suggestion: Add the earlier teaching of alemán → alemana and consonant-ending nationality agreement to taughtBefore, ensuring it precedes this task, or provide an appropriate lexical gloss.

sources: Course contract rule 1.

findings.location: task.hints[0].blocks[0].text: «Питання з питальним словом (¿De dónde…?) починається з цього слова.»
findings.description: This is an absolute word-order rule that Spanish does not have. An interrogative group can include a preceding preposition, and other material can precede it, as in ¿Tú de dónde eres?
findings.suggestion: Describe the specific cue de dónde as meaning «звідки», without claiming that every question containing an interrogative word starts with that word.

items.notes: The transcript and answer key otherwise agree.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, direct interrogatives, interrogative prepositional groups and their position (from memory).
